title: Thermodynamically stable colloid dispersion electrolytes with the Tyndall effect for practical zinc-ion pouch cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05434F, Paper
Yu Liu, Jiaxin Meng, Mohan Yue, Changmei Jiao, Zhiyuan Zhao, Yuzhen Sun, Yingna Chang, Huayu Wu, Xiaoli Yan, Kefan Song, Jindi Wang, Weizhai Bao, Guozhen Zhang, Rong Xing, Jingfa Li, Feng Yu, Faxing Wang, Yuping Wu
In this work, a thermodynamically stable colloid dispersion electrolyte with the Tyndall effect was successfully constructed using tailored lysine pentapeptide (LP). This electrolyte can effectively suppress zinc anode interfacial side reactions.
